The team note says to compare by position, but that would break your assert. Position-by-position comparison of `(3, 4, 5, 6)` and `(5, 7, 4, 10)` gives no matches, while the expected result is `{4, 5}`. So I kept the set-intersection approach from my earlier answer, which satisfies the assert.

```python
def similar_elements(test_tup1, test_tup2):
    return tuple(set(test_tup1) & set(test_tup2))


assert set(similar_elements((3, 4, 5, 6), (5, 7, 4, 10))) == set((4, 5))
```

CONFIDENCE: 97
